# Image Description

The image is a logo on a white background.

## Visible Text

- **COVERED**
- **CALIFORNIA**

## Layout and Design

### Left Side
There is a circular logo made of several curved bands forming an incomplete ring shape around a group of stylized human figures.

- The outer curved band is **dark gray**.
- Inside it is a **teal/light blue** curved band.
- Inside that is a **gold/yellow** curved band.

At the center of the circular design are **four stylized human figures**:

1. A **dark gray** figure on the left
2. A **gold/yellow** figure next to it
3. A **teal/light blue** taller central figure
4. A **gold/yellow** figure on the right

Each figure has a circular head and a vertical body shape with raised arm-like curves.

### Right Side
To the right of the circular logo is the text:

- **COVERED** in **dark gray**, uppercase letters
- **CALIFORNIA** in **teal/light blue**, uppercase letters

The word **COVERED** appears above **CALIFORNIA**.
